setup.name: STRK
reasons: 1H score 60/100 measures deterministic rule agreement, not probability of profit.
1H decision uses closed 1D bullish / 4H neutral / 1H neutral EMA trends; 1H RSI 41.9, ATR 3.83%. All displayed context closes by this decision candle.
Relative 1H volume 3.64× versus the previous 20 1H bars; actual 24-bar 1H taker-buy base-volume share 47.4%.

UTC-session VWAP uses reported quote/base volume totals from 1H bars. The last 48-bar 1H candle volume profile and POC are approximate: volume is spread uniformly across each candle's high-low range, not measured from trade-level volume at price.
Order blocks, liquidity sweeps and FVGs are causal price-action heuristics, not proof of institutional orders or future fills. Pivots require two right-side closed candles before use.
Conditional 1H plan: wait for relevant EMA trend alignment, a fresh bullish 1H closed-candle structure confirmation, positive required MACD momentum, and sufficient 1H taker-buy volume before entry.
confirmations: Await 1D and 4H and 1H bullish EMA agreement
Recent bullish structure confirmation on a closed 1H candle
Await 1H relative volume ≥1.1× and actual taker-buy share ≥52%
invalidations: Stop 0.0706 is a fixed simulated exit level; a gap can cause a larger realized loss.

A new bearish closed 1D and 4H and 1H EMA trend requires reassessment and prevents new 1H long qualification. Published simulation entry, stop and targets stay fixed; trend changes do not trigger an automatic exit.
Unfilled 1H recommendations expire 24 hours after their decision candle; maximum simulated hold after entry is 72 hours. Reassess after any data gap or exchange outage.

structure.description: BOS: closed through a swing that was already confirmed by two right-side candles.
Heuristic order block: body midpoint of the last opposing candle within ten bars before this confirmed break. Known only at the break; not proof of institutional orders.
Three closed candles leave a bearish low-to-high price gap around a displacement candle; FVG midpoint, not an exchange order-book imbalance.
Wick crossed a previously confirmed swing low and closed back above it; candle-based liquidity sweep heuristic.
